# GitHub Actions

The fork uses GitHub-hosted Linux and native Windows runners. Windows process checks run under `pwsh`. The core qualification verdict requires both lanes; fixture coverage never stands in for authenticated account or desktop export evidence. `ci.yml` retains the Linux complete unit suite and profile-composition check. `core-qualification.yml` builds the standard core, installs distributable archives in an independent consumer, and runs native lifecycle checks. `extensions-preview.yml` can publish only after that reusable qualification succeeds. Repository-scoped `contents: write` belongs only to the publication job. Secrets never enter build jobs or pull requests. No macOS support claim is made by these workflows.
